title: Study of TRAVATAN in Subjects With Iris Pigmentation Changes
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to monitor iris pigmentation changes over a 5-year period in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension. To be eligible for the study, these individuals must have experienced an iris pigmentation change while previously dosing with TRAVATAN.
study_population: Patients were identified and enrolled from 23 investigational centers in the US.
